description: Figure: apo(a) protease-like domain lysines, solvent exposure from AlphaFold v6 versus the plasminogen-aligned residue, showing the three apo(a)-specific lysines and that no numbering scheme yields a Lys216
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
lysdf = pd.read_csv("out/apoa_protease_domain_lysines.csv")
d = lysdf.sort_values("rel_SASA", ascending=True).reset_index(drop=True)
spec = d.PLG_residue != "K"          # apo(a)-specific lysine (PLG has something else)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.2),
                       gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [1.45, 1]})

# ---- panel A: exposure ----
cols = ["#c0392b" if s else "#5b7fa6" for s in spec]
ax[0].barh(range(len(d)), d.rel_SASA, color=cols, edgecolor="black", linewidth=.6)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(d)))
ax[0].set_yticklabels([f"{r}  (chymo {('%d'%c) if pd.notna(c) else 'ins'})"
                       for r, c in zip(d.residue, d.chymotrypsin)], fontsize=9)
for i, (v, p, pr) in enumerate(zip(d.rel_SASA, d.pLDDT, d.PLG_residue)):
    ax[0].text(v + .02, i, f"pLDDT {p:.0f}   PLG:{pr}", va="center", fontsize=8, color="#333")
ax[0].axvline(.20, ls=":", c="grey"); ax[0].axvline(.50, ls=":", c="grey")
ax[0].text(.20, len(d) - .3, " buried |", fontsize=8, color="grey", ha="right")
ax[0].text(.52, len(d) - .3, "| exposed", fontsize=8, color="grey")
ax[0].set_xlim(0, 1.28); ax[0].set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility (Shrake-Rupley, isolated domain)")
ax[0].set_title("A  Lysines of the apo(a) protease-like domain\n"
                "red = not a lysine in plasminogen", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# ---- panel B: numbering test ----
systems = ["P08519\nabsolute", "domain-local\n(Ile1820=1)", "chymotrypsin", "PLG precursor\n(P00747)",
           "PLG mature", "plasmin light\nchain (Val562=1)"]
occupant = ["Leu216\n(KIV-2)", "Gly2035", "Gly2011", "Gly216\n(pre-domain)",
            "Gly216\n(pre-domain)", "Val2026"]
ax[1].bar(range(6), [1] * 6, color="#d8dde3", edgecolor="black", linewidth=.6)
for i, o in enumerate(occupant):
    ax[1].text(i, .5, o, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5)
    ax[1].text(i, 1.06, "no Lys", ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#c0392b", fontweight="bold")
ax[1].set_xticks(range(6)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(systems, fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_yticks([]); ax[1].set_ylim(0, 1.3)
ax[1].set_title('B  Residue found at position 216 in each numbering system\n'
                'the "Lys216" of PMID 41177455 is not placeable from the abstract',
                fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
